template/json#

A Json as the strings of a text template: {{user.name}} reads member name of member user.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

TextTemplate("Hi {{user.name}}").string(JsonTemplateStrings(ParsedJson(text).root()));

Description#

A Json as the strings of a text template: {{user.name}} reads member name of member user.

Strings, numbers, booleans and null become text; an object or array at a leaf is NonScalarTemplateValue, a missing member MissingTemplateValue.

Public API#
